meta.title: Shamiyana: plan weddings, birthdays and community events
meta.description: Budgets split to the rupee, a timeline worked back from your date, vendor checklists, a guest list and AI ideas for your city and season.

footer.ai: Ideas, menus and suggestions are written by Google Gemini from your event details. Check prices and availability with vendors before you pay.
footer.local: Your plans are saved in this browser only.

storage.blocked: This browser is blocking storage, so changes won't be kept after you close the tab.
storage.full: Browser storage is full, so the last change wasn't saved. Delete an old plan or download a backup.
storage.recovered: Some saved data couldn't be read. It was set aside and a fresh start was made.

plans.heading: Your plans
plans.limit: You can keep up to {n} plans. Delete one to start another.

form.intro: Start with the basics. The budget, timeline and checklists appear straight away; AI ideas follow in a few seconds.

typeHints.birthday: From a first birthday to an 80th

form.title: Event name
form.titleHint: For example, Winter wedding in Jaipur. The name stays on your device and is not sent to the AI.
form.guestsHint: Your best estimate. You can change it later.
form.notesHint: Venue ideas, must-haves, family customs. Please leave out names and phone numbers.

sampleNotes.wedding: Outdoor pheras if the weather allows.
sampleNotes.birthday: Ground floor only, Dadi uses a walker.

errors.title: Enter the event name, 1 to 80 characters.
errors.city: Enter the city or town, 2 to 60 characters.
errors.datePast: Pick an event date from today on.
errors.dateFar: Pick an event date within three years.
errors.guests: Enter the number of guests, a whole number from 1 to 5,000.
errors.budget: Enter the total budget, from ₹5,000 to ₹50 crore.

overview.allDone: Every task is done. Enjoy the day.

ai.disclosure: Written by Google Gemini from your event details. Guest names are never sent.

tasks.w_budget_guests: Fix the date or muhurat, the budget and the most guests you can host, with the families
tasks.w_book_venue: Visit and book the main venue
tasks.w_roka: Fix the roka date and the gifts to exchange
tasks.w_book_caterer: Book the caterer after a tasting
tasks.w_book_decor: Book the decorator and agree colours and flowers
tasks.w_book_priest: Book the priest or officiant and confirm the muhurat
tasks.w_outfits: Order the outfits for every function
tasks.w_book_makeup: Book the makeup and hair artist
tasks.w_book_music: Book the DJ, dhol or band, and a baraat band if you have one
tasks.w_block_rooms: Block rooms for guests travelling in
tasks.w_choreo: Book a choreographer and set sangeet rehearsals
tasks.w_menu_tasting: Lock the menu for each function
tasks.w_transport: Book the ghodi or car for the baraat or arrival, and transport for guests
tasks.w_save_date: Send save-the-dates so guests travelling in can book trains and flights
tasks.w_tent_power: Book a tent, a generator and an electrician if any function is outdoors or at home
tasks.w_registration: Get the documents ready to register the marriage. If you marry under the Special Marriage Act, give notice 30 days to 3 months before the wedding
tasks.w_parking_security: Plan parking, valet and security for every venue
tasks.w_shagun_keeper: Ask someone you trust to look after the shagun envelopes and cash
tasks.w_trials: Do the makeup trial and final fittings
tasks.w_haldi_supplies: Get haldi, flowers and outfits for the haldi
tasks.w_final_count: Give the caterer the final head count
tasks.w_reconfirm: Reconfirm every vendor with timings and contacts
tasks.w_emergency_kit: Pack an emergency kit with pins, medicines, chargers and cash
tasks.w_day_contacts: Hand a coordinator the list of vendor contacts
tasks.b_guests_date: Fix the date and the guest list
tasks.b_book_venue: Book the venue, or plan the space at home
tasks.b_memory_book: Collect photos and messages for a memory book or video
tasks.b_theme: Choose a theme and order the decor
tasks.b_entertainment: Book the entertainment, such as games, a magician or music
tasks.b_caterer: Plan the menu or book a caterer
tasks.b_elder_access: Check step-free access, comfortable seating and a nearby toilet for older guests
tasks.b_kid_safety: Check allergies and set up supervision and first aid
tasks.b_rsvp_count: Confirm replies and the final count
tasks.b_playlist_photos: Make the playlist and set up a photo corner
tasks.c_committee: Form the organising committee and give everyone a role
tasks.c_budget_sponsors: Fix the budget and the sponsorship target
tasks.c_book_ground: Book the ground or hall and the tent
tasks.c_police_permission: Apply to the local police for loudspeaker and event permission
tasks.c_local_permission: Get permission from the society or municipal office
tasks.c_sound_stage: Book the sound, lights, stage and performers
tasks.c_food: Arrange food stalls or a caterer
tasks.c_publicity: Put up posters and post in society and neighbourhood groups
tasks.c_puja: Order the decor, lights and anything the puja or prayers need
tasks.c_donations: Set up a donation desk with receipts and a UPI QR code
tasks.c_prizes: Arrange prizes, referees and a match schedule
tasks.c_volunteers: Recruit volunteers and brief each of them
tasks.c_fire_safety: Ask the fire office whether the tent needs a fire NOC, and plan exits and extinguishers
tasks.c_cleanup_kit: Arrange gloves, bags and a municipal waste pickup
tasks.c_first_aid: Set up a first-aid desk and note the nearest hospital
tasks.c_waste: Place wet and dry bins and book a cleanup crew
tasks.c_walkthrough: Walk through the site with the volunteers, checking exits, extinguishers and wiring
tasks.c_stalls: Allot stalls, fix stall fees and draw the layout
tasks.c_power: Arrange a temporary power connection and a licensed electrician
tasks.c_toilets_water: Arrange drinking water and enough toilets
tasks.c_help_desk: Set up a help desk for lost children and lost items

vendors.heading: Vendors
stepList: Shortlist three options and compare what each includes.
Get the quote in writing with the date, inclusions and cancellation terms.
Pay the advance digitally and keep the receipt.

venue: How many guests can it seat and serve at once?
Is there a backup if it rains, and power backup?
Until what time is music allowed?
Can we bring our own caterer and decorator?
Is the rent waived if we order a minimum number of plates?
Is a generator included, and is diesel extra?
catering: What is the price per plate, and what is the minimum?
Can we do a tasting before we pay the advance?
Are serving staff, crockery and counters included?
Is GST included in the quote?
How are extra plates counted and charged?
Can Jain food be cooked in separate utensils?
cake: How far ahead do you need the order?
decor: Which flowers are fresh and which are artificial?
How long do setup and teardown take?
photo: How many photos and how long a film do we get, and when?
Who exactly will shoot on the day?
Is a second shooter or drone included?
Are drones allowed at this venue?
attire: When is the final delivery date?
beauty: How many people can you get ready, and by when?
entertainment: How long is the set, and is overtime charged?
Do you bring your own sound and lights?
Will you keep to the local sound limits and stop by 10 pm outdoors?
invitations: Can you send a digital version too?
rituals: What does the puja need, and do you bring it?
How long will the ceremony take?
transport: Is fuel and the driver's allowance included?
What happens if a vehicle breaks down?
Are tolls, parking and night charges extra?
stay: Is there a group rate, and until when are rooms held?
gifts: Can you pack and label them?
permits: What documents does the application need?
How many days does approval take?
sanitation: Do you separate wet and dry waste?
When will the crew arrive and leave?

guests.heading: Guests
guests.privacy: The guest list stays in this browser. It is never sent to the AI and is left out of share links.
guests.name: Name or household
guests.mismatch: The plan says {plan} guests; your list expects {list}.
guests.empty: No guests yet. Add households one at a time; the counts update as replies come in.
guests.nameError: Write a name in 1 to 80 characters.

ideas.heading: Ideas
ideas.savedEmpty: Ideas you save from the AI, a photo or the chat appear here.

photo.heading: Ideas from a photo
photo.intro: Upload a venue, decor, invitation or outfit photo. It is shrunk on your device and its location data removed, then sent once to Gemini. Shamiyana does not keep it.
photo.ready: Ideas from your photo are ready.

errors.type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.read: Couldn't read that photo. Try another one.

refine.heading: Ask for changes
refine.intro: Try “Bring the budget down to 15 lakh” or “Add a task to book a dhol player”. Nothing changes until you tick and apply it.
refine.label: Your message

share.heading: Share this plan
share.intro: The link carries the plan itself, so anyone with it can open their own copy, including the event name and the amounts agreed and paid. The guest list, vendor notes and your notes for the AI are left out, and the copy makes its own AI ideas.
share.label: Share link
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the link and copy it.
share.tooLong: This plan is too large for a link. Download a backup file instead.
share.failed: Couldn't build a link for this plan. Download a backup file instead.

downloads.heading: Download
downloads.badFile: That file isn't a Shamiyana backup.

imported.heading: Open a shared plan?
imported.body: Someone shared “{title}” with you. Opening it adds a copy to your plans; your own plans don't change.
imported.bad: This share link is damaged or incomplete.
